Name: Clint Mass Shop Expansion
Author: ApocGaming1992
Description:
[center]This mod expands upon Clint's Blacksmith shop by adding a slew of new items. All items that are included are in the following link: [/center]
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Minerals][center]﻿[/center][center]﻿﻿Stardew Valley Wiki - Minerals[/center]
[/url]﻿For the prices of most of the items, just round up the gemologist sell price or sell price if no gemologist price is listed to the nearest tens place.
For Example:
[b]
[u]Quartz:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] ﻿[b]Sell Price -[/b] [i]25g[/i]
[*] ﻿[b]Gemologist Sell Price - [/b][i]32g[/i]
[*] ﻿[b]My Sell Price/ Mod Sell Price -[/b] [i]40g[/i]
[/list] ﻿
[b][u]A Few Other Items Added:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*][b] ﻿[/b][b]Iridium Ore Price:[/b] [i]900g[/i]
[*] ﻿[b]Clay: [/b][i]200g[/i]
[*] ﻿[b]Copper Bar: [/b][i]400g[/i]
[*] ﻿[b]Iron Bar:[/b] [i]1000g[/i]
[*] ﻿[b]Gold Bar:[/b] [i]2000g[/i]
[*] ﻿[b]Iridium Bar: [/b][i]5000g[/i]
[/list] ﻿

[i][u][b]Note:[/b][/u][/i]
[list]
[*] ﻿[i]Prices may be altered in the shops.json file. Just change the "StockPrice": [insert value here]. To determine what item price is being[/i]
[/list] [i] ﻿ ﻿altered, look at the "Item Names": [item name here].[/i]
[b]
[u]Requires: [/u][/b]
[list]
[*] ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework Mod[/url]
[/list][list]
[*]﻿ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6529]Expanded Preconditions Utility Mod[/url]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: You can buy bars, clay, minerals, geodes, geode minerals, gems, and iridium ore now at Clint's Shop.
